'''Bek Rabor''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Bek Rabor was stationed in the [[Imperial Outpost (Dantooine)|Imperial Outpost]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bek Rabor appears as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
